name: Can interior trim improve my home's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can interior trim improve my home's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: While interior trim primarily serves aesthetic purposes, well-installed trim can indirectly contribute to minor improvements in a home's energy efficiency. By sealing gaps around windows and doors, trim helps to minimize drafts and air leakage, which can otherwise lead to heat loss or gain. Caulking applied along the edges of baseboards and casings seals small openings between walls and floors, further reducing unwanted air transfer. Maine Results, Inc. ensures that all trim installations are sealed properly, contributing to a more comfortable indoor environment by reducing drafts, though the primary impact on energy efficiency comes from insulation and window quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Well-installed and properly sealed interior trim can help reduce drafts around windows, doors, and walls, indirectly contributing to minor energy efficiency.
